method: Two 12-second 4K drag repeats per CPU/browser and GPU/native cell; one idle sample each and one 90-second retained replay soak at 1 Mbit/s/100 ms. Serial runs without concurrent builds/tests. Same independent scene observer; not physical scanout. Idle timestamps expire by design, so only CPU/traffic is reported. Process-tree RSS can count shared mappings more than once.
